title: Make Time for Traction Together
coreMove: Build a child's traction plan with them so important activities and free time are chosen before conflict starts.
sourcePressure: The child section applies traction and timeboxing through shared family planning, collaboration, and prior intent rather than reactive conflict.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would impose a parent-made schedule and call it responsibility.

hook: Make Time for Traction Together as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: young rock climber balancing homework and gym night
exampleSpecs.audience: parent and child planning together before arguments
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice and homework both lose when the plan is implicit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they place homework, dinner, and climbing prep on the same sheet before choosing screen time
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A climbing chalk bag sits beside a shared evening plan.

exampleSpecs.domain: middle-school robotics teammate planning build week
exampleSpecs.stakes: team commitments need a plan the child owns
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child moves build night and math practice blocks on a magnetic board himself
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A gear-tooth magnet holds a build-week board.

exampleSpecs.domain: child actor managing audition prep and rest
exampleSpecs.stakes: performance and recovery compete unless chosen in advance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, lines are squeezed in late; after, the child picks two rehearsal blocks and a rest block
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A script side packet lies beside a rest-block sticker.

exampleSpecs.domain: young gardener planning chores and game time
exampleSpecs.audience: grandparent teaching prior intent through seasonal tasks
exampleSpecs.stakes: plants wilt if chores are remembered only after play
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child chooses watering before game time and draws the watering can in the first square
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A brass watering can sits beside a hand-drawn day strip.

exampleSpecs.domain: teen preparing for a driver's permit exam
exampleSpecs.audience: parent turning study into a shared plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: cramming and conflict grow when study is undefined
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they review the missed signs and let the teen schedule two practice-test blocks
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A road-sign flashcard deck rests beside a permit booklet.

exampleSpecs.domain: siblings sharing a tablet during school break
exampleSpecs.audience: caregiver helping kids plan turns before fighting
exampleSpecs.stakes: fairness improves when turns are chosen before the device appears
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: each child writes one planned use and one off-screen block before the tablet leaves the drawer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A felt drawer sleeve holds a tablet beside two name cards.

tryThisNowSpec: Invite the child to place one important activity and one free-time block on tomorrow's plan before screens come up.
